lore_ko: 시험 기간 밤샘 중 캠퍼스에서 감염된 서울시립대학교(University of Seoul) 학생. 학생증과 이어폰을 그대로 하고 있다.

art.style: flat color vector, bold dark outline (3.5px at 400px width), no gradients, not pixel art
art.view: front, idle pose (left arm limp, right arm reaching forward-right, head tilted)

pivot.note: normalized, origin top-left; at the feet

art.facing: right (reaching arm points right); flip horizontally for left
art.recommended_filtering: linear/bilinear (not nearest-neighbor, since this is not pixel art)

identifying_features: navy hoodie with 'UNIVERSITY OF SEOUL' chest lettering
student ID card on teal lanyard
one white earbud dangling from right ear
bite wound on exposed right forearm
grey-green skin, sunken eyes, pale yellow irises
torn left knee on jeans, untied right shoelace
